#@ requires 1 == 1
    #@ ensures \result == "(set_empty ())" or \result == "(set_new 0)"
    #@ assigns self._abstract_ops
    def _handle_setlit_expr(
        self,
        expr: Dict[str, Any],
        local_refs: Set[str],
        invariant_ctx: bool,
        subst: Optional[Dict[str, str]],
    ) -> str:
        elts = expr.get("elts", [])
        if not elts:
            self._add_abstract_op("val set_empty () : int")
            return "(set_empty ())"
        self._add_abstract_op("val set_new (x: int) : int")
        return "(set_new 0)"
